bottom_line: In EUROPA, perindopril 8 mg once daily versus placebo reduced the primary endpoint (cardiovascular mortality, MI, or cardiac arrest) with a 20% relative risk reduction (95% CI 9–29).
implications: Based on the reported primary endpoint results (488 [8.0%] vs 603 [9.9%]), this trial supports that perindopril reduced the composite of cardiovascular mortality, MI, or cardiac arrest compared with placebo, with a reported 20% relative risk reduction (95% CI 9–29; p=0.0003). Cardiovascular mortality alone was not significantly reduced (14% [–3 to 28], p=0.107), and total mortality alone was not significantly reduced (11% [–2 to 23], p=0.1), so the document’s numbers do not license a conclusion of a statistically significant reduction in these individual mortality endpoints.

major_points.text: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre trial in stable coronary heart disease without apparent heart failure.
major_points.quote: We did a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre study.

major_points.text: After a 4-week run-in in which all patients received perindopril, 12,218 were randomised to perindopril 8 mg daily or placebo.
major_points.quote: After a run-in period of 4 weeks, in which all patients received perindopril, 12 218 patients were randomly assigned perindopril 8 mg once daily (n=6110), or matching placebo (n=6108).

major_points.text: Primary endpoint was a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, and cardiac arrest with successful resuscitation.
major_points.quote: The primary endpoint was a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, and cardiac arrest with successful resuscitation.

major_points.text: Treatment withdrawal due to cough was more common with perindopril than placebo.

criticisms.text: The anticipated follow-up needed to be prolonged, and 13% of patients did not take part in the extension of the trial.

criticisms.text: Average use of study medication was 3.7 years during 4.2 years of follow-up, making the improved outcome a conservative estimate of benefit.
criticisms.quote: The average use of study medication was 3·7 years during 4·2 years of follow-up. Thus the reported improved outcome is a conservative estimate of the benefit of perindopril.
